name: streamRead
description: Pull the next chunk of an in-flight stream identified by streamId.

inputs.name: deadlineMs
inputs.description: Absolute epoch-ms deadline (JS t0 + 90s) by which the native side must resolve. On expiry the host resolves {status:'timeout'} and cancels the stream.

inputs.name: waitMs
inputs.description: How long the host may hold this read waiting for new chunks before resolving. 0/absent = return the current queue immediately (legacy poll behaviour).
